text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san! Happy birthday! Um, about your 
present...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm thinking of getting you a blanket! 
What kind would you like...!? Please, tell 
me your preference!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you. Whatever you give me, I'll 
be happy."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Still, Curren-chan told me you had very 
particular preferences! I really wanted to 
match your tastes, Ayabe-san.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah... that's right, you'll need a catalog, 
won't you?! I'm so sorry, I'll go fetch 
one right away, please hold on a moment—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Faux fur, with pile long enough for 
your hands to sink into, maybe...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Anti-static, you say... That makes it easy 
to handle.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, mhm! Fluffy! Anti-static! All right, 
got it!! Okay, okaaaay...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Please don't force yourself to look for 
it, okay?
